name: coinbase-trading-app
description: Full-stack real-time Coinbase Exchange trading dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "SERVER,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "cyan,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
